Category: Luxury

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

A cyberdeck series used by the best NetWatch agents and a frightening beast in terms of its offensive capabilities.

Iconic Cyberdeck with 14 slots for Programs or Hardware. Can only be used while installed in a Neuroport Cyberdeck Port. After a user Jacks In with this cyberdeck, they can activate a single non-Black Ice Program or use a single Interface Ability without a NET Action. While using this Cyberdeck, the user has one additional NET Action every turn. When using this Cyberdeck and using a Quickhack or Programs that deals damage, the user may roll an additional 1d6 and drop the lowest roll before applying the damage, and any Quickhacks or Programs used by this Cyberdeck have their duration (if they have one) doubled.

Slots: 14

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Gear).
